title: If I reset calibrations xdrip+ nerver connect again to xbridge2
symptom: In the last stable release, 20191027-6d4d283, and some nightly builds before it, if I insert a new sensor or reset calibrations and introduce new blood tests, xdrip+ never connects to my G4 via xbridge2. Reinstalling the previous stable release, 20190518-14a03a7, works fine.
